verdict.rationale: Whether a product's own source is available under an open license is a fair question for any software product, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no open-source license for Lovable itself. The docs only show that users can browse, download and Git-sync the code of the apps Lovable generates for them, and that the built-in backend builds on Supabase's open-source foundation. Neither is Lovable's own source under an open license, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
